## `neuro.map.forEach`

Instance method on `Map.prototype`.

> Executes a provided function once per each key/value pair in the Map, in insertion order.

## Signatures

```ts
forEach(input: { map: <receiver>; callbackfn?: (value: V; key: K; map: Map<K; V>) => void; thisArg?: any; prompt?: string }): Promise<void>
```

The `prompt` field is optional. When omitted (or set to an empty string)
the wrapper falls back to the native `Map.prototype.forEach` and returns a
resolved Promise without contacting the LLM. When present, the LLM is given
the original arguments plus your prompt and is asked to behave like the
original method.
